prompt:
A realistic product screenshot of a native Apple app in dark mode, stock macOS and iOS look: near-black window, slightly lighter grey surfaces, thin hairline dividers, San Francisco system font, white text with muted grey secondary text. System blue for the accent, orange for "waiting on you", green for passing, red for failed. In a chat, the person's message sits on the right in a dark blue bubble and the assistant's reply is plain text with no bubble; a rounded message box at the bottom with a round send arrow. Terminal output in a monospaced font on a dark grey ground. No pills or badges, no gradients, no glow, no avatars, no logos. Draw NO design annotations, measurements, colour codes, font names or labels describing the design: the only words on screen are the app copy, spelled exactly.

Scene: the orchestrator is an AI agent chat that watches every coding project. Projects: wheel, kennel, alpha. In the orchestrator chat the person asks "what needs me?" and the orchestrator replies "Two things. alpha's tests broke after the last merge, two failures in parser.rs. And kennel's codex wants to run cargo publish, which can't be undone. I've put both on the board." Mirrored panes (live copies of panes that live in other spaces) each carry a small header with the source and a small link-arrow icon: "alpha · terminal" shows "$ make test", "test parser::expressions ... FAILED" and "test parser::statements ... FAILED" in red, a few "... ok" lines, "test result: FAILED. 46 passed; 2 failed". "kennel · codex" is an agent chat whose last message is "Ready to publish kennel 0.4.2 to crates.io." with a request card "Run cargo publish?" and buttons Deny, Always allow, Allow. "wheel · claude" is an agent chat showing "Building the orchestrator view" with a running line "Working · cargo build 41s".

Wide macOS window. Title row: red, yellow, green window buttons, a sidebar icon, a speech-bubble mode icon, the title "Orchestrator", and on the right a ⌘K button, a pin and a plus. A thin bottom bar reads "Connected to wheeld" on the left and ".claude 5h 12% · 7d 46%" on the right. Presentation SIDEBAR: the orchestrator chat is a sidebar column on the LEFT, about a quarter of the window wide, holding the exchange and its message box. The rest of the window is the orchestrator's own space: an ordinary grid of three tiled panes with hairline gaps, each a mirrored pane with its source header: alpha terminal on the left half, kennel codex top right, wheel claude bottom right. A small segmented control with three icons (full, sidebar, floating) at the top of the sidebar, the second selected.
